zh.explain: 冷水还没烧成开水，既不冷也不烫，还只是温凉的，不会有什么力道。而人要通畅地行走天下，全赖自身本领高强。
divination: 犯案入狱会遇到大赦，生病了会得到良医救治。
要寻求财富和前程，则需得到贵人的指点。
zh.summary: 此封平善用事之象。所祈求之事平稳处理则会大吉大利。

verse: The cold water has yet to come to a steaming boil.
Neither cold nor hot, just cool enough.
To roam the world with success,
Strong skills you will need to have.
interpretation: A criminal obtains a general pardon.
The sick will meet a good physician.
Guidance from distinguished people will help you in your pursuits for wealth and success.
meaning: Go about your usual affairs with compassion,
everything will turn out steady and auspicious.
en.explain: Before the water is boiled, it is neither cold nor hot. It is just lukewarm. At this stage, the water is not too useful. For one to roam the world without hindrance, it all depends on one's strong skills and capabilities.
divination: Prisoners will be pardoned and the sick will meet and be cured by a good doctor. To seek wealth and a better prospect, you will need guidance from benefactors.

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (typo for 此卦), kept. zh item 顺景如意 (for 顺境) kept as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.
